meta.rule: Only promotions printed on the bank's own pages are listed. 'no-offer-displayed' means the official product page fetched on 2026-10-21/22 showed no opening cash bonus and no promotional APY — it does not prove that no targeted or mailer offer exists.

promotions.offer: $200 cash bonus
promotions.requirement: Be a new Barclays Tiered Savings customer (current or previous Barclays savings/CD customers are ineligible); open by 10/31/2026; fund the new account with at least $25,000 within the first 30 days; keep at least $25,000 for 120 consecutive days. Bonus posts about 60 days after the 120-day period and is reported on Form 1099-INT as interest.
promotions.value_note: $200 on a $25,000 deposit equals 0.80% of principal, one time — on top of the APY earned during the 120 days.

promotions.offer: $50 or $400 cash bonus (plus a 1.10% APY boost for up to 6 months)
promotions.requirement: Open a SoFi Checking and Savings account and set up eligible direct deposit of $1,000 or more; the $400 tier is the top advertised amount ('up to $400'). The 1.10% APY boost requires the eligible direct deposit (or $5,000 of qualifying deposits every 31 days) within 60 days and lasts up to 6 months.
promotions.deadline: 2027-12-31 (account-opening deadline stated for the APY boost)
promotions.value_note: $400 on a $25,000 deposit equals 1.60% of principal, one time; the boost adds 1.10% APY for six months on top of the 3.30% base rate.

promotions.offer: 3-month promotional APY increase of 1.00%
promotions.requirement: Referral-based: the promo increase is on top of the stated Online Savings APY for 3 months; after 3 months the account earns the then-current standard APY. Marcus illustrates a combined APY of 3.75% for a year if one referral is made and the standard APY is unchanged.
promotions.value_note: Rate promotion, not a cash bonus. Requires a referral — the referral terms themselves were not opened in this session, so eligibility details are flagged for manual review.

promotions.offer: 'Special Member Rates' 3.55% APY
promotions.requirement: Headline APY is labelled 'Special Member Rates'. The same page's calculator shows 'Our HYS APY 2.85%', so the conditions that unlock 3.55% are not stated on the page. Confirm the rate at application.

promotions.offer: No opening cash bonus or promotional APY displayed
No opening cash bonus or promotional APY displayed
promotions.requirement: The page does advertise a six-month waiver of the monthly maintenance fee for new accounts.
promotions.value_note: Fee waiver only; the fee amount itself is rendered as a placeholder on the page.

promotions.offer: No opening cash bonus or promotional APY displayed
No opening cash bonus displayed on the product page
promotions.requirement: Citi states that APY is determined by rate region, Relationship Tier and applicable promotion — a promotional APY may apply by location and is not printed on the page.
promotions.value_note: Location-based promotional rates not verifiable for New York in this session.

promotions.offer: No opening cash bonus displayed; relationship rate bump up to 3.50% APY
promotions.requirement: Relationship rates require a Bank Smartly Checking account, Safe Debit account or Bank Smartly Visa Signature card and combined qualifying balances (see rate tiers).
promotions.value_note: Rate-tier promotion rather than a cash bonus.

promotions.offer: No opening cash bonus displayed; TotalRewards tier boost of up to +0.03 percentage points
promotions.requirement: Enroll in the PNC TotalRewards Select Tier (Silver $25,000+, Gold $100,000+, Platinum $500,000+ of average eligible balance).
promotions.value_note: A 0.03-point boost on 0.03% is immaterial next to a 3%+ high-yield account.

promotions.offer: No opening cash bonus or promotional APY displayed
No opening cash bonus displayed
promotions.value_note: Ally's savings page markets buckets/boosters rather than a cash bonus.

promotions.offer: No opening cash bonus displayed
No opening cash bonus displayed for 360 Performance Savings
promotions.requirement: The savings category page does advertise a separate 11-month 360 CD at 4.40% APY (a CD, not a savings account).
promotions.value_note: CD offer excluded from this savings-account comparison.

promotions.offer: No opening cash bonus displayed for Online Savings
promotions.requirement: The $200 bonus on the Barclays site applies to the separate Tiered Savings account.

promotions.offer: 5.00% APY for the first 6 months, then 4.21% (balances under $250,000) or 3.50% ($250,000+)
promotions.requirement: Open and fund an Axos ONE Savings account and hold an Axos ONE Checking account with qualifying activity: $1,500 in monthly direct deposits plus a $1,500 average daily balance, or $5,000 in direct deposits plus a $5,000 average daily balance. Qualifying deposits must post by the 25th of the month. If the requirement is missed the rate is 1.00%.
promotions.value_note: On $250,000 the six-month 5.00% intro is worth about $6,250 of interest before the tier drops to 3.50%, a blended 4.25% for year one ($10,618) versus $8,750 at a flat 3.50%.

promotions.offer: Up to $800 cash bonus (promo code SAVE800) plus 4.25% APY for 6 months
promotions.requirement: Use promo code SAVE800 when opening a new Premium Savings account and fund it within the stated window (2026-09-22 through 2027-01-10). The bonus is tiered by the amount deposited; $800 is the top tier advertised on the page.
promotions.value_note: $800 is 0.32% of a $250,000 deposit, one time. The 6-month 4.25% rate is worth more: about $625 extra interest on $250,000 versus the 3.75% base rate.

promotions.offer: 0.35% APY boost for the first 6 months (4.00% standard + 0.35% = 4.35%)
promotions.requirement: New Openbank High Yield Savings customers only. $500 minimum to open. No checks or debit card on the account; the bank requires a trusted device for login.
promotions.value_note: The boost adds about $440 of interest on $250,000 over six months; the standard 4.00% still pays $10,000 a year after it ends.

promotions.offer: BOOST50 promo code: 4.25% APY for 6 months (0.75% on balances under $5,000)
promotions.requirement: Apply promo code BOOST50 when opening a new Platinum Savings account. Promo window 2026-09-29 through 2026-12-15. $100 minimum to open. Boost applies to balances up to $9,999,999. After 6 months the rate returns to 3.75% on $5,000+ and 0.25% below $5,000.
promotions.value_note: The boost adds about $625 of interest on $250,000 over six months. Under $5,000 the boosted rate is 0.75%, not 4.25%.

promotions.offer: No opening bonus or promotional rate advertised
promotions.requirement: The official product page was checked on 2026-10-22 and showed no opening bonus, promo code or introductory APY — only the 4.20% rate for new accounts.
promotions.value_note: Rate-only account: 4.20% pays $10,500 a year on $250,000, the highest flat verified rate in this comparison.
